title: HarnessApiService
responsibility: Maps project and agent operations to the selected local console or hosted API, preserving sessions and revision admission.

inputs.name: HarnessApiService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Optional settings configure the API URL, project, mode, token environment name, snapshot branch and commit, and timeout; other declared option keys are not read by this service. The default object is {}; URL resolves from options.url, HARNESS_API_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:5690, project from options.project or HARNESS_API_PROJECT, tokenEnv defaults to HARNESS_API_TOKEN, timeout to 30000 ms, and omitted mode selects hosted when a project is set or the URL is non-loopback; tokenEnv must match /^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$/i and timeout must be a safe integer from 1 through 3600000.

inputs.name: HarnessApiService.read.resource
inputs.description: Names the resource to retrieve; local reads pass it as the agent method, hosted projects reads use /api/projects, and other hosted reads use the encoded selected-project resource route.

inputs.name: HarnessApiService.read.input
inputs.description: Record of query values for the requested resource, passed inside the local agent request or converted to hosted query parameters; hosted reads omit null and undefined values and stringify the rest. Defaults to {}.
inputs.unknownReason: The requested resource determines the set and types of query values.

inputs.name: HarnessApiService.call.method
inputs.description: Name of the agent operation to invoke. createPlan, startRun, approve, and openThread trigger a snapshot writable-tip check; other method strings are forwarded without that preflight.

inputs.name: HarnessApiService.call.input
inputs.description: Record of parameters forwarded as the agent operation input. This service does not validate its keys; guarded write methods also require a writable branch tip.
inputs.unknownReason: The selected agent operation determines which values are accepted in its parameter record.

inputs.name: HarnessApiService.call.requestId
inputs.description: Optional request identifier forwarded to the agent only when it is truthy; an empty string is omitted. Defaults to undefined.

outputs.name: HarnessApiService.connect
outputs.description: Connection result returned after hosted mode successfully requests /api/projects or local mode creates and saves a session. On success connected is literal true and server is the HTTP adapter origin.

outputs.name: HarnessApiService.snapshot
outputs.description: Project snapshot read with the configured branch and commit, each sent as null when absent. The resolved snapshot requires project, revision, writable, and entities; capabilities and project.id are optional.

outputs.name: HarnessApiService.read
outputs.description: Resolves to the HTTP adapter response for the selected resource after local-agent or hosted-route dispatch, without reshaping it. ApiResponse is imported from the HTTP adapter and its fields are not defined in these implementation files, so a matching JSON example cannot be derived here.

outputs.name: HarnessApiService.call
outputs.description: Resolves to the HTTP adapter response for the local or hosted agent request, without reshaping it. ApiResponse is imported from the HTTP adapter and its fields are not defined in these implementation files, so a matching JSON example cannot be derived here.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when tokenEnv is not a valid environment-variable name, mode is not local or hosted, timeout is not a safe integer from 1 through 3600000 ms, or local mode uses a non-loopback URL. It is also raised when a local API response has no nonempty session token, a hosted route needs a project that was not selected, or a guarded agent write is not at the writable branch tip or is pinned to options.commit.

outputs.name: HarnessApiService.connect
outputs.description: Connection result returned after hosted mode successfully requests /api/projects or local mode creates and saves a session. On success connected is literal true and server is the HTTP adapter origin.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when local session creation receives no nonempty string token from the API.

outputs.name: HarnessApiService.snapshot
outputs.description: Project snapshot read with the configured branch and commit, each sent as null when absent. The resolved snapshot requires project, revision, writable, and entities; capabilities and project.id are optional.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the hosted snapshot route has no selected project or local session creation receives no nonempty string token.
